verdict.rationale: Requesty's first-party MCP Gateway lets you register MCP servers, explore their tools, and configure authentication, including per-user keys. Connected assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor and Roo Code then reach those tools through Requesty, with usage analytics on top. Missing for 10: evidence that tools from registered MCP servers can be invoked directly within Requesty's own chat-completions requests (rather than only exposed to downstream assistants), detailed setup/transport documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Register new servers, explore available tools, and configure authentication settings.
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API
Connect your favorite AI coding assistants to Requesty's MCP Gateway for seamless access to external tools and services.
Enterprise plan users can manage their own personal API keys for MCP servers, enabling individual authentication while maintaining centralized server management.
